title: WorkerDispatchFrame
description: Server-to-worker dispatch payload. Sent over WebSocket as a single text frame ({type: 'dispatch', ...}) and reused as the JSON body of GET /v1/workers/{workerId}/dispatch?wait=25s long-poll responses. See worker-protocol spec: 'Dispatch over WebSocket', 'Long-poll dispatch fallback'.

branch.description: Git branch name the worker SHOULD use for its worktree.

prompt.description: Rendered Liquid template from active config (no secret references).

ackDeadlineSec.description: Seconds the cloud waits for an ack before revoking the lease.

artifactUploadURLs.description: R2 presigned PUT URLs valid for the lease duration. Workers MUST upload large outputs here, NOT via the events endpoint.
